censusRecord.name: host-file
censusRecord.reason: Conservative whole-file host boundary inventory. LockFile review: process exit synchronously closes disk handles before beep shutdown and ctx.onExit/snapshot handoff; this releases final-owner locks and pending read reservations, rejecting late opens without invoking guest callbacks. Adopted live-parent handles remain separately owned until that parent exits. Existing onExit callback and other invocation ownership remain pending. SetLocalTime review: synchronous process calendar offset state is shared through host context construction; no guest callbacks, suspended invocation or context restoration added. Process-alias review 20261021: default process_ctl returns explicit unsupported/invalid errors for new operations; it creates no object, invokes no callback and restores no guest context. Startup review a339395: process_spawn default adds forceSpawn/showCmd parameters and still returns unsupported zero; no retained callback added. Integration 20261022: Queued GL review: owned immutable command snapshots may outlive the producer import; borrowed/query batches retain their existing broker lease. Pre-GDI synchronization awaits ordered render admission before readback and ownership release, without invoking or restoring guest context. Teardown drains admitted work before renderer retirement.
